description: A page's pictures. Every page has a title card as its featured image, drawn by Sightkick in the brand's colour and font. Add a screenshot of a real web page or upload your own picture; neither edits the body: put its url in an with update_page edit. A featured image needs no tag. action: - screenshot(articleId, url, alt?, featured?, position?): Screenshot a public web page (a product's homepage, a pricing page) at 1280×800 with cookie banners hidden, and add it. Counts against the plan's monthly screenshots; a failed capture costs nothing. Returns mediaId, url and a dated caption to put under it. - upload(articleId, url?, data?, alt, featured?, position?): Your own picture, by public url (up to 8 MB) or base64 data (up to 700 KB): PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF. Returns mediaId and url. featured: true puts it in place of the title card. - alt(mediaId, alt): Set an image's alt text. - featured(mediaId): Make an image the featured one. - position(mediaId, position): Its place in what the site receives. - remove(mediaId): Delete an image the body no longer shows (not the title card: feature another picture instead). Can't be undone.
name: update_page_images
title: Change a page's images
